draw.rule: three units, a Latin hypercube over the scored units' ranges (the ranges the instruction states): per property the range is cut into three equal strata, unit i takes stratum perm[i] with perm sorted by sha256(key|prop|perm|stratum), its place in the stratum is sha256(key|prop|pos|i) / 2**256; 4 decimals; key from os.urandom(16); a draw in which a unit lies within 2 % of every property's range of a scored unit is drawn again with a new key
